verdict.rationale: Retell documents a Press Digit tool that lets single- and multi-prompt agents press keypad digits to navigate DTMF IVR menus during outbound calls. That covers the DTMF and IVR parts of the story. Nothing in the evidence pack covers voicemail detection or leaving a voicemail. missing for 10: voicemail detection, leaving voicemail messages, DTMF/IVR support beyond outbound calls, independent or hands-on corroboration of IVR navigation

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail

citations.quote: Enable Retell single or multi-prompt agents to navigate DTMF-input IVR menus by pressing keypad digits during outbound calls to reach the right department.
